sections.content: Live Intrusion Prevention System dashboard. Source: FortiAnalyzer. Generated automatically by DBDOME.

sections.query: SELECT initcap(severity) || ' (' || total || ')' AS label, total FROM siem.v_ips_severity_summary ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 WHEN 'medium' THEN 3 WHEN 'low' THEN 4 WHEN 'info' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END
SELECT initcap(severity) AS "Severity", total AS "Count", pct || '%' AS "% of Total" FROM siem.v_ips_severity_summary

SELECT to_char(hour_bucket, 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "Time", critical AS "Critical", high AS "High", medium AS "Medium" FROM siem.v_ips_timeline WHERE hour_bucket >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY hour_bucket
sections.chart_text: Critical, High and Medium Intrusions Timeline (Last 7 Days)

sections.query: SELECT intrusion_type AS "Type", total AS "Count" FROM siem.v_ips_type_summary LIMIT 10
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS "#", intrusion_type AS "Intrusion Type", total AS "Counts" FROM siem.v_ips_type_summary

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS "#", attack_name AS "Attack Name", COALESCE(cve_id, '') AS "CVE-ID", COALESCE(intrusion_type, '') AS "Intrusion Type", total AS "Counts" FROM siem.v_ips_detected WHERE severity = 'critical'

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS "#", attack_name AS "Attack Name", COALESCE(cve_id, '') AS "CVE-ID", COALESCE(intrusion_type, '') AS "Intrusion Type", total AS "Counts" FROM siem.v_ips_detected WHERE severity = 'high'

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS "#", attack_name AS "Attack Name", COALESCE(cve_id, '') AS "CVE-ID", COALESCE(intrusion_type, '') AS "Intrusion Type", total AS "Counts" FROM siem.v_ips_detected WHERE severity = 'medium'

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS "#", source_ip AS "Attack Source", critical AS "Critical", high AS "High", medium AS "Medium", total AS "Counts", pct_of_total || '%' AS "Percent of Total Attacks" FROM siem.v_ips_sources LIMIT 20

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS "#", victim_ip AS "Attack Victim", critical AS "Critical", high AS "High", medium AS "Medium", total AS "Counts", pct_of_total || '%' AS "Percent of Total Attacks" FROM siem.v_ips_victims LIMIT 20

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 WHEN 'medium' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, total DESC) AS "#", attack_name AS "Intrusion Name", intrusion_type AS "Intrusion Type", initcap(severity) AS "Severity", total AS "Counts" FROM siem.v_ips_blocked

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 WHEN 'medium' THEN 3 WHEN 'low' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, total DESC) AS "#", attack_name AS "Intrusion Name", intrusion_type AS "Intrusion Type", initcap(severity) AS "Severity", total AS "Counts" FROM siem.v_ips_monitored

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 WHEN 'medium' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, total DESC) AS "#", attack_name AS "Attack Name", initcap(severity) AS "Severity", total AS "Attack Counts" FROM siem.v_ips_http_attacks
